events.title: Grouping, MacOS Support and more
events.summary: Just a few quick updates.MacOS SupportI uploaded a working MacOS demo. The binary will run on both Intel and Mac Native. If you have been waiting for a Mac demo it is now available.GroupingI decided to remove fast travel from choices. You can still use it from your field unit but characters will follow you and group up now when you offer to take them somewhere. events.title: Steam Deck and Controller Support
events.summary: Steam Deck Support The Red Weight now has full controller support, and a version of the interface built for the Steam Deck's screen. On the Steam Deck, the game runs at the panel's native 1280x800 instead of letterboxing a 720 canvas, and I went hunting for more room on top of that, shaving 10 extra pixels out of the title bar and handing every reclaimed row to the story text box.
